# Test pictures

Real hand photos for the MediaPipe gesture test (`tools/make_hand_video.py --real`).
They are MediaPipe's own test pictures (https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/), Apache
License 2.0 – see `app/ui/lib/mediapipe/LICENSE-mediapipe.txt`.

* `hands_open.jpg` – two open hands (the test cuts out the right one for "one hand")
* `hand_fist.jpg` – a fist
